game.name: Battlefield : Bad Company 2 (USA)(En,Fr)(Limited Edition)
game.desc: Battlefield: Bad Company 2 on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter that invites you to join a squad of four unusual soldiers. Members of a unit made up of the worst of the US army, they find themselves forced to operate behind enemy lines to prevent the Russians from getting their hands on a weapon of mass destruction. A multiplayer mode is of course present and allows you to pulverise the entire scenery you cross.
